post.description:
Request generation of new OTP
Requests are processed asynchronously
This method will return a request id / messageId that can be used to track status of the request.
- to request otp to be sent to any channel (sms, email, voice) a destination address must be provided.
- if no destination address is provided, OTP is returned synchronously.
- if any one destination is provided, OTP is scheduled for asnch generation / delivery.
- new param returnOTP should be set to TRUE only if you expect otp code returned in api response.
  OTPs are meant to be delivered out-of-band. Please use this flag only if you have secured requesting client application properly.
